summary: Maastricht University's Brightlands Talent Scholarship gives two full scholarships a year to top non-EU students on master's programmes linked to the Brightlands Chemelot and Maastricht Health campuses. It covers tuition, living costs of €20,150 for a one-year or €38,750 for a two-year master's, insurance, visa costs and pre-academic training. Complete your master's application by 10 December 2026 and the scholarship application by 1 February 2027.
meta_title: Maastricht Brightlands Talent Scholarship 2027: full funding
meta_description: Maastricht's Brightlands Talent Scholarship pays tuition and up to €38,750 living costs for two non-EU master's students. Apply by 1 February 2027.
covers: Living costs of €20,150 for a 13-month (one-year) master's or €38,750 for a 25-month (two-year) master's, paid by the International Services Desk.
Health and liability insurance, visa application costs and the two-week pre-academic training.
eligibility: Nationals of countries outside the EU, the EEA, Switzerland and Suriname, who have never been enrolled in a degree programme in the Netherlands.
No older than 35 on 1 September 2027, with a GPA of 7.5 out of 10 or higher. Candidates without a master's degree are preferred.
Admission to a participating master's for 2027–2028: the programmes affiliated with the Chemelot campus and the Maastricht Health campus, listed on the scholarship page.
A commitment to act as a Brightlands and Maastricht University ambassador.
how_to_apply: Submit your full application for a participating master's, meeting every admission requirement, before 10 December 2026.
Apply for the scholarship between 1 October 2026 and 1 February 2027 at 23:59 CET. You cannot add or replace documents after you submit.
A shortlist is interviewed online. Candidates hear their status in April 2027 and a final decision by the beginning of May 2027.
watch_out: Air tickets are not included, and a cleaning fee of about €75 is paid upfront to Maastricht Housing.
Only two scholarships are given each year, so apply for other funding as well.
Maastricht's NL-High Potential scholarship uses the same 10 December master's deadline and covers most other programmes.
documents: A complete master's application before 10 December 2026
The scholarship application, submitted once by 1 February 2027

faq.q: How many Brightlands Talent Scholarships are there?
faq.a: Two full scholarships per academic year.
Master's programmes affiliated with the Brightlands Chemelot campus and the Maastricht Health campus; the scholarship page links the list.
A complete master's application before 10 December 2026, and the scholarship application by 1 February 2027 at 23:59 CET.
